q_diagnostic.scope: deterministic published source-correction diagnostic; no stochastic likelihood
q_diagnostic.units: km/s for dv,q and fitted coefficients; q/c is dimensionless logarithmic redshift correction

definitions.additive_fit: dv = n_sourceward.ICRS dot a; unweighted least squares
definitions.multiplicative_fit: q = n_sourceward.ICRS dot b; unweighted least squares
definitions.multiplicative_intercept_fit: q = b0 + n dot b; diagnostic chart intercept

rounding_comparison.conditional_assumption: both tabulated velocities independently rounded to nearest integer km/s after their underlying definitions
rounding_comparison.status: diagnostic comparison only, not an established stochastic rounding law

limitations: A good deterministic fit does not establish the exact upstream frame-conversion algorithm.
This does not infer an observer velocity independently of catalogue construction.
The log-redshift chart is not automatically a Lorentz rapidity or a complete finite boost; direction conventions, transverse Doppler and aggregation matter.
No distance/photometry deboost p is supplied by this diagnostic.
Reported directions/amplitudes are deterministic fitted chart coefficients; no parameter covariance or uncertainty is estimated.

response_offset: O_m[(A+1)*(q_published-n.a)/c]; subtract from y for the declared fixed logarithmic-reference mean
reference: a is a deterministic least-squares representation of published additive correction; not an independent physical observer estimate
physical_status: conditional first-order optical/source mean; complete distance p, finite boost and method aggregation still unresolved
same_experiment: all source rows, quoted-z operators, covariance and design fixed; known offset is propagated, not a new redshift catalogue
rounding_body: Under +/-0.5 km/s independent coordinate intervals for continuous Vh and V3k, q error bounded by derivative supremum; fixed reference a, no stochastic rounding law; coordinate support only, not simultaneous attainment
separation_power_bound: unchanged: common additive source correction cancels from difference of mean families
